title: Customer-specific requirements
requirement: Evaluate CSRs and include them in the QMS scope (CSR matrix)

title: Product safety
requirement: Documented process for product-safety related products and processes

title: Corporate responsibility
requirement: Anti-bribery policy, code of conduct, ethics escalation (whistle-blowing) policy

title: Responsibility for product requirements
requirement: Persons responsible for conformity can stop shipment and production

title: Risk analysis
requirement: Risk analysis includes lessons learned from recalls, audits, field returns, complaints, scrap

title: Preventive action
requirement: Documented process to reduce the impact of risks and prevent recurrence

title: Contingency plans
requirement: Documented contingency plans for key equipment, supply, utilities, labour, IT/cyber-attack; tested; reviewed

title: Quality objectives - supplemental
requirement: Objectives cover customer requirements at relevant functions, levels and processes

title: Plant, facility and equipment planning
requirement: Multidisciplinary planning with risk, lean principles and capacity re-evaluation

title: Measurement system analysis
requirement: Statistical MSA for every inspection, measurement and test system in the control plan

title: Calibration / verification records
requirement: Documented process for calibration records, out-of-tolerance reaction and customer notification

title: Laboratory requirements
requirement: Internal lab scope and competence; external labs ISO/IEC 17025 accredited or customer-approved

title: Competence - supplemental
requirement: Documented process to identify training needs, including awareness of customer requirements

title: On-the-job training
requirement: OJT for new or changed jobs, including contract and agency staff

title: Internal auditor competency
requirement: Documented process to verify internal auditor competence (core tools, CSRs, process approach)

title: Second-party auditor competency
requirement: Competence of auditors who audit suppliers

title: Employee motivation and empowerment
requirement: Documented process to motivate employees and promote innovation

title: QMS documentation
requirement: Quality manual with processes, interactions, and a CSR matrix showing where CSRs are addressed

title: Record retention
requirement: Retain PPAP, tooling, design and PO records for the active part life plus one calendar year

title: Engineering specifications
requirement: Documented process to review customer engineering standards within 10 working days

title: Customer-designated special characteristics
requirement: Comply with customer requirements for designating and controlling special characteristics

title: Manufacturing feasibility
requirement: Multidisciplinary feasibility analysis for new or changed products and processes

title: Design and development - supplemental
requirement: Documented design process for product and manufacturing process design

title: Special characteristics
requirement: Documented process to identify, document and control special characteristics

title: Product approval process
requirement: Product and manufacturing approval process conforming to the customer's (e.g. PPAP)

title: Supplier selection process
requirement: Documented supplier selection process with risk assessment

title: Type and extent of control
requirement: Documented process to identify outsourced processes and select controls

title: Statutory and regulatory requirements
requirement: Documented process so purchased products meet statutory requirements in receiving and destination countries

title: Supplier QMS development
requirement: Suppliers certified to ISO 9001 at minimum, developing toward IATF 16949

title: Supplier monitoring
requirement: Documented process and criteria: delivered quality, disruptions, delivery, special status

title: Control plan
requirement: Control plans for pre-launch and production with reaction plans; updated on changes

title: Verification of job set-ups
requirement: Set-up verification with documented instructions and first/last-off comparison

title: Total productive maintenance
requirement: Documented TPM system: maintenance objectives, spare parts, predictive and preventive maintenance

title: Identification and traceability
requirement: Traceability analysis and plan for all automotive products

title: Control of changes - supplemental
requirement: Documented change-control process with validation and customer notification

title: Temporary change of process controls
requirement: Documented process and list of approved alternate controls, with verification and restart criteria

title: Layout inspection and functional testing
requirement: Layout and functional tests per control plan (typically annually)

title: Control of reworked product
requirement: Documented rework process with risk analysis and customer approval where required

title: Control of repaired product
requirement: Documented repair process with customer concession

title: Nonconforming product disposition
requirement: Documented process for disposition of nonconforming product not subject to rework or repair

title: Monitoring manufacturing processes
requirement: Process studies on new processes; maintain capability per customer requirements

title: Customer satisfaction - supplemental
requirement: Monitor delivered quality, disruptions, field returns, delivery, premium freight, customer notifications

title: Internal audit programme
requirement: Documented audit programme covering QMS, manufacturing process and product audits over 3 years

title: Manufacturing process audit
requirement: Audit every manufacturing process over 3 years, covering all shifts, using the process approach

title: Product audit
requirement: Audit products at appropriate stages for conformity to all requirements

title: Management review inputs - supplemental
requirement: Cost of poor quality, process effectiveness, field failures, warranty, potential failures from FMEA

title: Problem solving
requirement: Documented problem-solving process with containment, root cause, verified actions and lessons learned

title: Error-proofing
requirement: Documented process for error-proofing methodology, tested at defined intervals
evidence: poka-yoke list exists, no verification frequency

title: Warranty management systems
requirement: Documented warranty management process when warranty applies, including no-trouble-found

title: Continual improvement - supplemental
requirement: Documented continual improvement process with methodologies and objectives

title: Ford customer-specific requirements
requirement: Latest CSR document reviewed, mapped in the CSR matrix and implemented

title: Stellantis customer-specific requirements
requirement: Latest CSR document reviewed, mapped in the CSR matrix and implemented
